units.source_text: 下午，大竹七段在棋盘前坐了一会儿，回到了房间，在咽喉处涂了药，又转回来。

en.t: In the afternoon, 7-dan Otake sat for a while in front of the board, went back to his room, applied medicine to his throat, and then returned.

units.source_text: 周围飘荡着一股药味儿。

en.t: The smell of medicine drifted through the air around him.

units.source_text: 他也滴了眼药，还带了两个怀炉。

en.t: He had also put in eye drops and brought two pocket warmers with him.
